We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the amount owed on your account with Frontier State Bank. We understand that you have requested validation of this debt.

We will review the account information and verify the accuracy of the amount owed. Our records indicate that the current balance on your account is $6,322.61.

We will investigate the discrepancies you have mentioned and provide you with a written response within 30 days, as required by law. If our investigation confirms that the amount owed is incorrect, we will take necessary steps to correct the error.

Please be advised that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe the amount owed is still incorrect after our investigation. You may also request a copy of the validation notice we provide, which will include the amount owed, the original creditor, and the charge-off date.

We appreciate your cooperation in this matter and will keep you informed of any updates.
